title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful capabilities available to all users.

title: Enhanced File & Media Controls
summary: Empower your content creation with intuitive controls to effortlessly upload, manage, download, and customize the display of all your files and images directly within the editor.

title: Our Dynamic Product Roadmap Is Here!
summary: We've launched a new dedicated roadmap page, giving you a clear, real-time look at what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what we're planning for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our new and improved checkboxes are now bigger, more visually appealing, and fully draggable, making your task management more efficient than ever.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience when collaborating with your team on documents.

title: Seamless Collaboration on Shared Content
summary: Experience enhanced collaboration as you effortlessly discover and engage with all the great ideas and content shared by your connections.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, making Noeko accessible and intuitive for a global audience.

title: Noeko Is Now Open Source
summary: To empower our community with greater control and foster transparent collaboration, we are thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now officially open source.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflows with an enhanced knowledge map, featuring powerful filtering by tags and time, plus clear visibility into your shared content.

title: Precision Search & Curated Knowledge Views
summary: Swiftly pinpoint and organize your crucial information using powerful new filters, comprehensive sorting, and the ability to save your custom search configurations as easily accessible knowledge views.

title: Adaptive Content Views
summary: Discover innovative new ways to visualize and interact with your connected content, allowing you to tailor how information appears for ultimate clarity and streamlined organization.

title: Unlock More with Noeko: Self-Hosting and New Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to host Noeko on your own servers or choose from new cloud-hosted paid plans that provide advanced features and greater resource flexibility for your team.

title: Discover Stunning New Themes
summary: We're enhancing our current theme collection and adding several brand new, stylish options to help you customize your workspace like never before.

title: Smart Welcome Messages
summary: We are ensuring our greetings always precisely match the time of your day, delivering a more personalized and intuitive welcome every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag and List Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly unapplying tags or deleting items directly from any list, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, directly into your workflow for richer insights.
